title: Preserving DatetimeIndex and TimedeltaIndex frequency across index unions and concatenation
answers: Why does pd.concat lose DatetimeIndex or TimedeltaIndex freq depending on Series order?
Why does pd.DataFrame constructor set DatetimeIndex freq to None with CustomBusinessDay?
How does union_indexes restore shared DatetimeIndex frequency after pairwise combinations?
body:
Symptom: pd.concat or DataFrame constructor loses the freq (sets freq=None) of a DatetimeIndex or TimedeltaIndex depending on the order of input Series.
Root cause: pandas/core/indexes/api.py:union_indexes combines inputs pairwise; non-contiguous intermediate unions drop non-inferable offsets (like CustomBusinessDay) when falling back to generic set union with freq='infer'.
Fix pattern: Do not attempt to preserve frequency during intermediate pairwise union steps; restore the shared input frequency once on the final index using pandas/core/indexes/api.py:_maybe_restore_freq in pandas/core/indexes/api.py:union_indexes and pandas/core/indexes/api.py:_get_combined_index.
Constraints: Applies only when result is monotonic increasing with freq is None, all inputs are DatetimeIndex or TimedeltaIndex sharing the exact same non-None freq, and type(result._data)._validate_frequency passes without raising ValueError.
applies: Index union and concatenation of DatetimeIndex or TimedeltaIndex in pandas/core/indexes/api.py.
